name: Kimi K2 Instruct
summary: Kimi K2 Instruct is a 1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 32B active parameters, 384 experts and a 128K context window. Moonshot AI uses a Modified MIT license that adds a branding obligation for very large commercial services.

rights.question: Commercial use
rights.notes: The license broadly tracks MIT permissions.

rights.question: Modification
rights.notes: Modification and derivative works are permitted.

rights.question: Redistribution
rights.notes: MIT copyright and permission notice requirements remain.

rights.question: >100M monthly active users
rights.notes: Qualifying commercial products/services must prominently display “Kimi K2”.

rights.question: >$20M monthly revenue
rights.notes: The same prominent-display obligation applies above the revenue threshold.

deployment.notes: Official model supports Transformers with remote model code.
Official model page documents vLLM serving.
Official model page documents SGLang serving.
The published model repository is tagged for FP8 deployment.
Moonshot's repository also documents broader optimized runtime support.
